about.title: Traditional recipes, modern presentation
about.p1: Boulevard 1909 is a city restaurant blending classic flavors of Azerbaijani cuisine with a minimalist presentation.
about.p2: Located in the quiet part of the New Boulevard. A bright interior, spacious tables, and a calm atmosphere — ideal for family lunches, business meetings, or romantic dinners.
about.featKitchenText: Shah pilaf, kebabs, traditional dishes and national desserts.
about.featPhilosophyText: Selected local produce, balanced portions and modern service.
about.featAtmosText: Calm, refined, with background music. Service centered around the guest.
about.cardTitle: Shah pilaf, selected kebabs and desserts
about.cardText: For groups and private events, write to us — we adapt the menu to your format.
